title: Robustness as a Transferable Skill: Cross-Task Adversarial Defense for Vision-Language-Action Policies
description:
arXiv:2611.18702v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are vulnerable to adversarial visual perturbations, while defenses often require task-specific adversarial fine-tuning. We investigate whether robustness learned on source manipulation tasks can protect independently specialized target policies without target-side adversarial training. We first show that even a single source defense update improves robustness on held-out tasks, establishing cross-task defense
